character.description: Cuter version of the existing Unity B companion: tiny olive moss-green living creature, rounded soft body, small leaf-like head tufts, stubby legs, short tail, wide gentle dark eyes, timid first-journey companion energy. Preserve current B identity, 3/4 view, muted earthy palette, dark outline, and non-human creature silhouette. Cute proportion correction: make the face/head mass slightly smaller and less mascot-like than the previous cute candidate, while making the eyes larger relative to the face by about 1-2 logical pixels. Keep the body compact and creature-like. Do not add scarf, bag, clothing, props, human accessories, eyebrows, mouth detail, or new markings.

chroma_key.name: magenta
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 4 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

idle.action: subtle breathing, tiny blink, shy attentive bounce; keep feet mostly planted and do not change identity; keep head/face mass small while the larger eyes carry the cute read

walk.action: tiny soft companion walk with short steps, slight body bob, tail and leaf tufts following the motion; no running or exaggerated comedy; keep head/face mass small while the larger eyes carry the cute read

style: True 32x32 indie pixel art after extraction, 1px dark outline, muted olive moss and warm earth palette, compact creature proportions. Make the face/head shape slightly smaller and quieter than the previous cute candidate, but make the eyes larger, rounder, and clearer as the main cute feature. Preserve the existing B silhouette and do not add scarf, bag, clothing, props, or new body markings. No mascot gloss, no anime, no painterly rendering, no gradients, no bright toy colors.
